items.title: Crypto news site Cointelegraph seeks buyer after web traffic plunges
items.snippet: The amount of money the crypto media firm has been shopping itself for was not revealed.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin backs crypto ‘bunker mode’ amid rapid AI math advances
items.snippet: Ethereum researchers say crypto users should consider moving funds to fresh addresses, warning AI could threaten private-key security before quantum computers do.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо ETH -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
